subject: A self-scoring Yes/No vocabulary-size test for modern Ukrainian, drawn from the Ukrainian Frequency lemma list
method: 60 real lemmas and 60 constructed pseudowords, 5 of each per thousand-rank frequency band (12 bands, top 12000 lemmas). Each pseudoword is a real lemma from elsewhere in the same band with one deterministic phonological letter substitution, kept only if it collides with none of the 12000-lemma list, another generated pseudoword, or a 333k-headword reference Ukrainian dictionary (dict_uk / LibreOffice dictionaries, MPL-1.1) checked at build time. This is a constructed instrument; it has not been independently validated against a psycholinguistic norming study.

files.about: The full item bank: id, form, isReal, band, and (real items) source rank or (pseudowords) source lemma and rank.

citation: Lawrence, J. (2026). Ukrainian Frequency: a self-scoring vocabulary-size test (v1.0.0). jakelawrence.xyz/research/ukrainian-frequency/vocab-test. Item bank drawn from the Ukrainian Frequency lemma list, itself derived from UberText 2.0 (Chaplynskyi, 2023).
